1.consolidated_definition: Manifestar, asegurar. Dejar claro, dejar establecido algo. Calco de estructura, usual. No obstante, Méndez hizo claro que a partir del 26 de marzo, Hacienda abrirá los Centros de Ayuda al Contribuyente, que estarán brindado el servicio de forma gratuita para aquellos que llenan la forma larga. En esos centros también se hará de forma electrónica
1.en_consolidated_definition: To manifest, to assert. To make clear, to establish something as a fact. A calque of structure, commonly used. However, Méndez made it clear that from March 26th onwards, the Treasury Department will open Assistance Centers for Taxpayers, which will provide service free of charge to those who fill out the long form. In these centers, this service will also be provided electronically.
